messages:
Mia (Docs): Heads-up — we're deprecating HSM plugin v1 in Private installs next month. Need to update onprem/KMS/HSM docs + migration playbook. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/842 (WIP). Airgap install notes will be touched. Anyone owning HSM copy?

David (Infra): I'll own network/iptables/nftables callouts. Quick question: does replacement require ephemeral egress to KMS CA during migration?

Sasha (Security): Yes — rotation needs a short window. We should add explicit steps for KMS key rollover + backup of PKCS11 mappings. Also note HSM vendor cert pinning.

Jules (Eng): I can draft the CLI snippet for onprem pkcs11 install. Example to add under 'Install' :
```bash
# enroll token
redwoodctl hsm enroll --slot 0 --token-label RDW-HSM
# rotate key
redwoodctl kms rotate --hsm-token RDW-HSM --force
```
Will push to PR.

Mia (Docs): Perfect. Two asks: 1) add short preflight checklist for sealed/offline sites (checklist bullets), 2) verify all internal links in that doc and the migration playbook.

Jules (Eng): preflight checklist draft:
- verify snat/proxy rules allow one-time 443 egress to vendor CRL (unless vendor certs bundled)
- confirm NTP sync within drift 5s
- verify cert chain bundle present
- PKCS11 access tested as root
I'll add to PR.

David (Infra): For sealed sites we should include sample nftables rule and systemd unit for the kms-proxy. Snippet:
```nft
table inet redwood_kms {
 chain output { type filter hook output priority 0; oifname "eth0" tcp dport 443 accept }
}
```
systemd override we'll attach.

Sasha (Security): Also add rollback steps for key rotation and note ACL for HSM management network (eg. 10.0.0.0/24).

Mia (Docs): Thanks. Can folks add a small 'what's changed' section at top summarizing deprecation timeline + compat matrix? We have to merge by 2026-05-10. @jules @david please double-check link anchors; my earlier PRs tripped the anchor linter.

deploy-bot: link-checker ran: /docs/private/hsm-migration.md -> 12 warnings (anchors missing).

Jules (Eng): I'll fix anchors and squash into one commit. @mia do we want a migration cheatsheet PDF for customers?

Mia (Docs): Yes — short 1-page checklist PDF would be great for CSM. I'll create a template and add to assets/.

David (Infra): FYI I'll coordinate with support to create a sample firewall rule set for Azure/AWS GWs.

Sasha (Security): Quick note: include HSM vendor-specific caveat: some HSMs don't support hot export; call it out.

Mia (Docs): Timeline: draft content by 2026-04-10, internal review 2026-04-20, merge by 2026-05-08. Assigning: @jules CLI + anchors, @david network snippets, @sasha security caveats. Ping here when pushed.

Jules (Eng): Started branch and pushed initial snippet to PR, will ping when pushed. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: PR 842 updated by jules — link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/842
